title: Sudoku Clan: Sudoku you play against friends
text: My 2021 Sudoku game is now Sudoku Clan, with real-time matches: races, duels, co-op and an 8-player Battle Royale. Free in your browser.

title: Murmur 1.7.3 is out
text: Murmur now has a private memory on the Mac: it keeps track of your people, promises and plans, and starts your day with a morning brief. Free for Mac and Windows.

title: This portfolio got a full rebuild
text: New programs, right-click menus, a resume you can download, and me. Try the MS-DOS Prompt, or ask me a question.
